name: Volkswagen diesel diagnostics and repair
summary: Diagnosing and repairing faults on Volkswagen Group diesel vehicles.
body: Warning lights, loss of power, smoke, poor starting and DPF or turbo warnings on Volkswagen Group diesel vehicles. Fault codes show which system has logged a problem; testing narrows down the cause before any parts are replaced. Describe the symptoms and any warning lights when you book.

name: Toyota Prius Hybrid
summary: Diagnosis and repair work on the Toyota Prius Hybrid.
body: Warning lights, hybrid system messages and running faults on the Toyota Prius Hybrid. Describe the symptoms and any warning messages on the dashboard when you book.

name: Toyota Corolla Hybrid
summary: Diagnosis and repair work on the Toyota Corolla Hybrid.
body: Warning lights, hybrid system messages and running faults on the Toyota Corolla Hybrid. Describe the symptoms and any warning messages on the dashboard when you book.

name: Gearbox problems
summary: Diagnosis and repair of gearbox faults.
body: Difficulty selecting gears, jumping out of gear, whining or grinding noises, and gearbox warning lights. Describe when the problem happens (cold, warm, in which gears) when you book.

name: Clutch problems
summary: Diagnosis and repair of clutch problems, including clutch replacement.
body: A slipping clutch, a high or heavy pedal, judder when pulling away, or noise when the pedal is pressed. Describe the symptoms when you book.

name: DPF problems
summary: Diagnosis of diesel particulate filter (DPF) faults and warning lights.
body: A DPF warning light can mean the filter is blocked or that a related sensor has a fault. Testing identifies which before any work is done. Tell us about your usual driving (short trips or long runs) when you book.

name: Turbo problems
summary: Diagnosis and repair of turbocharger faults.
body: Loss of power, limp mode, whistling or smoke can point to a turbo problem, but boost leaks, sensors and control faults cause similar symptoms. Diagnosis comes before replacing parts.

name: Injector problems
summary: Diagnosis and repair of fuel injector faults.
body: Rough running, misfires, poor starting, smoke or higher fuel consumption can be caused by injector faults. Testing identifies which injector, if any, is at fault.

name: Timing belt
body: Timing belt intervals are set by the manufacturer by mileage and age. On many engines a failed belt causes serious engine damage, so check when yours was last changed. Have your vehicle's service history to hand when you book.

name: Oil leaks
summary: Tracing the source of oil leaks and repairing them.
body: Oil on the driveway, a burning smell or a falling oil level. Oil can run a long way from where it escapes, so the source is traced before any repair.

name: Wiring faults
summary: Finding and repairing vehicle wiring faults.
body: Intermittent faults, warning lights that come and go, and components that stop working. Describe when the fault appears (wet weather, over bumps, when warm) when you book.

name: Loom wiring
summary: Diagnosis and repair of wiring loom faults.
body: Damaged, corroded or chafed wiring looms can cause several unrelated-looking faults at once. The affected section of loom is traced and repaired.

name: Electrical diagnostics
summary: Diagnostic work on electrical faults and warning lights.
body: Reading fault codes and testing circuits and components to find the cause of electrical faults and warning lights.
